subject.title: feat(mxc): add Windows MXC sandbox backend

question: May OpenClaw accept the exact-head `@microsoft/mxc-sdk`/`node-pty` dependency graph and the MXC SDK argv-carried base64 config transport for this prerelease external sandbox plugin after the stray sandbox export is removed?
rationale: Automation can remove the accidental export, but it cannot decide whether OpenClaw should own this first-party native sandbox dependency and local process-argv exposure boundary.

options.title: Approve After Export Removal
options.body: Remove the stray sandbox barrel export, approve the exact-head dependency graph, and accept the SDK argv transport for this prerelease external plugin.

options.title: Pause For Non-Argv Transport
options.body: Hold the PR until MXC offers or the plugin implements a transport that does not put encoded policy material in process arguments.

options.title: Defer First-Party MXC
options.body: Close or defer this core-repo PR and keep MXC experimental outside first-party OpenClaw release channels for now.

recommendation.title: Approve After Export Removal
recommendation.body: Remove the stray sandbox barrel export, approve the exact-head dependency graph, and accept the SDK argv transport for this prerelease external plugin.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the current assignee and have relevant sandbox/OpenShell history, making them the best available owner to route the security-boundary decision.
